spells.name: Alarm
spells.description: You set an alarm against intrusion in an area up to a 20-foot Cube. Audible Alarm: handbell sound for 10 seconds within 60ft. Mental Alarm: mental ping within 1 mile (awakens you if asleep).

spells.name: Animal Friendship
spells.description: Target a Beast you can see. It must succeed on a Wisdom save or be Charmed. Ends if you or allies damage it.
spells.upcast: Target one additional Beast for each level above 1.

spells.name: Armor of Agathys
spells.description: Gain 5 Temporary Hit Points. If a creature hits you with a melee attack while you have these points, they take 5 Cold damage. Ends if Temp HP are gone.
spells.upcast: Temp HP and Cold damage increase by 5 for each level above 1.

spells.name: Arms of Hadar
spells.description: Each creature in a 10-foot Emanation makes a Strength save. Fail: 2d6 Necrotic damage and no Reactions until its next turn. Success: half damage.
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d6 for each level above 1.

spells.name: Bane
spells.description: Up to three creatures make a Charisma save. If they fail, they subtract 1d4 from attack rolls and saving throws.
spells.upcast: Target one additional creature for each level above 1.

spells.name: Bless
spells.description: Bless up to three creatures. When a target makes an attack roll or saving throw, they add 1d4 to the roll.
spells.upcast: Target one additional creature for each level above 1.

spells.name: Burning Hands
spells.description: Each creature in a 15-foot Cone makes a Dexterity save. Fail: 3d6 Fire damage. Success: half damage. Flammable objects not worn/carried ignite.
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d6 for each level above 1.

spells.name: Buzzing Bee
spells.description: Target a creature you see. A spectral bee hovers around it. The target has Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception), Dexterity (Stealth), and Con saves for Concentration. It cannot benefit from being Invisible. The bee moves with the target if they stay within 120ft of you.

spells.name: Charm Person
spells.description: One Humanoid makes a Wisdom save (Advantage if you/allies are fighting it). Fail: Charmed for duration or until damaged. They are Friendly. Target knows it was Charmed when the spell ends.
spells.upcast: Target one additional creature for each level above 1.

spells.name: Chromatic Orb
spells.description: Make a ranged spell attack (Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder). On hit, deal 3d8 damage. If you roll doubles on d8s, the orb leaps to a target within 30ft of the first; make new atk/damage rolls. Leap limit depends on spell level.
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d8 per level above 1. Orb can leap up to spell level times.

spells.name: Color Spray
spells.description: Launch a dazzling array of flashing light. Each creature in a 15-foot Cone must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have the Blinded condition until the end of your next turn.

spells.name: Command
spells.description: Speak a one-word command to a creature. It must succeed on a Wisdom save or follow it on its next turn: Approach (move to you), Drop (drop held object), Flee (move away), Grovel (Prone), or Halt (no move/action).
spells.upcast: Affect one additional creature for each level above 1.

spells.name: Compelled Duel
spells.description: Force a Wisdom save. Fail: target has Disadvantage on attacks against others and can't move >30ft from you. Ends if you attack another, cast on another enemy, ally damages it, or you end turn >30ft away.

spells.name: Comprehend Languages
spells.description: Understand the literal meaning of any language you hear, see signed, or touch (written). Reading takes about 1 min per page. Doesn't decode secret messages.

spells.name: Create or Destroy Water
spells.description: Create 10 gallons of water in a container or as rain in a 30-foot Cube. Or destroy 10 gallons in a container or fog in a 30-foot Cube.
spells.upcast: Create or destroy 10 additional gallons, or increase Cube size by 5ft, for each level above 1.

spells.name: Cure Wounds
spells.description: A creature you touch regains Hit Points equal to 2d8 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.
spells.upcast: Healing increases by 2d8 for each level above 1.

spells.name: Detect Evil and Good
spells.description: Sense the location of any Aberration, Celestial, Elemental, Fey, Fiend, or Undead within 30ft. Also sense active Hallow effects. Blocked by 1ft stone/dirt/wood, 1 inch metal, or lead.

spells.name: Detect Magic
spells.description: Sense presence of magical effects within 30ft. Use a Magic action to see an aura around visible magic-bearing creatures/objects and learn the school of magic. Blocked by 1ft stone/dirt/wood, 1 inch metal, or lead.

spells.name: Detect Poison and Disease
spells.description: Sense location and kind of poisons, poisonous/venomous creatures, and magical contagions within 30ft. Blocked by 1ft stone/dirt/wood, 1 inch metal, or lead.

spells.name: Disguise Self
spells.description: Make yourself and belongings look different (including +/- 1ft height, weight). Must have same basic limb arrangement. Doesn't hold up to physical inspection. Study action vs spell DC reveals the disguise.

spells.name: Dissonant Whispers
spells.description: Force a Wisdom save on a creature you see. Fail: 3d6 Psychic damage and must use Reaction (if available) to move as far as possible from you. Success: half damage.
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d6 for each level above 1.

spells.name: Divine Favor
spells.description: Your weapon attacks deal an extra 1d4 Radiant damage.

spells.name: Divine Smite
spells.description: Take as a Bonus Action immediately after hitting with a Melee weapon or Unarmed Strike. Target takes extra 2d8 Radiant damage (+1d8 if it's a Fiend or Undead).
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d8 for each level above 1.

spells.name: Ensnaring Strike
spells.description: Take as a Bonus Action immediately after hitting with a weapon. Target makes a Strength save (Advantage if Large or larger) or is Restrained. While Restrained, it takes 1d6 Piercing damage at the start of its turns. A creature can use an action to make a Strength (Athletics) check to end the spell.
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d6 for each level above 1.

spells.name: Entangle
spells.description: Plants turn a 20-foot square into Difficult Terrain. Each creature (except you) in the area when cast must succeed on a Strength save or be Restrained. A creature can use an action to make a Strength (Athletics) check to end the condition.

spells.name: Expeditious Retreat
spells.description: Take the Dash action. Until the spell ends, you can take the Dash action as a Bonus Action.

spells.name: Faerie Fire
spells.description: Objects in a 20-foot Cube are outlined in light. Creatures in the Cube must succeed on a Dexterity save or be outlined. Outlined targets shed 10ft Dim Light, can't be Invisible, and attacks against them have Advantage.

spells.name: False Life
spells.description: You gain 2d4 + 4 Temporary Hit Points.
spells.upcast: Gain 5 additional Temporary Hit Points for each level above 1.

spells.name: Feather Fall
spells.description: Choose up to five falling creatures. Rate of descent slows to 60ft per round. If they land before the spell ends, they take no fall damage.

spells.name: Find Familiar
spells.description: Gain a familiar (Celestial, Fey, or Fiend spirit in animal form). It acts independently but obeys commands. You can communicate telepathically and see/hear through its senses within 100ft (Bonus Action). It can deliver Touch spells using its Reaction. It can't attack. Can be temporarily dismissed/summoned.

spells.name: Fog Cloud
spells.description: Create a 20-foot-radius Sphere of Heavily Obscured fog. Dispersed by strong wind.
spells.upcast: Radius increases by 20 feet for each level above 1.

spells.name: Goodberry
spells.description: Create 10 magical berries. A creature can use a Bonus Action to eat one, regaining 1 HP and gaining a day's nourishment.

spells.name: Grease
spells.description: Cover a 10-foot square with grease (Difficult Terrain). Each creature standing in it, entering it, or ending its turn there must succeed on a Dexterity save or fall Prone.

spells.name: Guiding Bolt
spells.description: Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, deal 4d6 Radiant damage. The next attack roll against the target before the end of your next turn has Advantage.
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d6 for each level above 1.

spells.name: Hail of Thorns
spells.description: Take as a Bonus Action after hitting with a Ranged weapon. The target and each creature within 5ft make a Dexterity save. Fail: 1d10 Piercing damage. Success: half damage.
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d10 for each level above 1.

spells.name: Healing Word
spells.description: A creature you see within range regains Hit Points equal to 2d4 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.
spells.upcast: Healing increases by 2d4 for each level above 1.

spells.name: Hellish Rebuke
spells.description: Take a Reaction after being damaged by a creature you see. Target makes a Dexterity save. Fail: 2d10 Fire damage. Success: half damage.
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d10 for each level above 1.

spells.name: Heroism
spells.description: A willing creature becomes immune to the Frightened condition and gains Temporary Hit Points equal to your spellcasting ability modifier at the start of each of its turns.
spells.upcast: Target one additional creature for each level above 1.

spells.name: Hex
spells.description: Curse a creature you see. Deal an extra 1d6 Necrotic damage to it on a hit. Target has Disadvantage on checks with one chosen ability. Move the curse as a Bonus Action if the target drops to 0 HP.
spells.upcast: Duration increases: 4h (L2), 8h (L3-4), 24h (L5+).

spells.name: Hunter's Mark
spells.description: Mark a creature you see as your quarry. Deal an extra 1d6 Force damage to it on a hit. Advantage on Perception/Survival checks to find it. Move the mark as a Bonus Action if the target drops to 0 HP.
spells.upcast: Duration increases: 8h (L3-4), 24h (L5+).

spells.name: Ice Knife
spells.description: Make a ranged spell attack: 1d10 Piercing damage on hit. Hit or miss, the shard explodes: target and creatures within 5ft make a Dexterity save or take 2d6 Cold damage.
spells.upcast: Cold damage increases by 1d6 for each level above 1.

spells.name: Identify
spells.description: Touch an object to learn its properties, attunement requirements, charges, and active spells. Touch a creature to learn spells affecting it.

spells.name: Illusory Script
spells.description: Write a message that only you and designated creatures can read. To others, it looks like an unknown script or has a different meaning. Truesight reveals the hidden message.

spells.name: Inflict Wounds
spells.description: Touch a creature and force a Constitution save. Fail: 2d10 Necrotic damage. Success: half damage.
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d10 for each level above 1.

spells.name: Insidious Rhythm
spells.description: Force a Wisdom save on a creature you see. Fail: target has Disadvantage on Intelligence checks and Constitution saving throws made to maintain Concentration. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.
spells.upcast: Target one additional creature for each level above 1.

spells.name: Jump
spells.description: Touch a willing creature. Once per turn, they can jump up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement.
spells.upcast: Target one additional creature for each level above 1.

spells.name: Longstrider
spells.description: Touch a creature. Its Speed increases by 10 feet.
spells.upcast: Target one additional creature for each level above 1.

spells.name: Mage Armor
spells.description: Touch a willing creature not wearing armor. Their base AC becomes 13 + Dexterity modifier. Ends if they don armor.

spells.name: Magic Missile
spells.description: Create three glowing darts of force. Each dart automatically hits a creature you see for 1d4 + 1 Force damage. Darts strike simultaneously and can hit one or multiple targets.
spells.upcast: Create one additional dart for each level above 1.

spells.name: Protection from Evil and Good
spells.description: Willing creature is protected against Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, and Undead. They have Disadvantage on attacks vs target. Target can't be possessed, Charmed, or Frightened by them (Advantage on saves if already affected).

spells.name: Purify Food and Drink
spells.description: Remove poison and rot from nonmagical food and drink in a 5-foot-radius Sphere.

spells.name: Ray of Sickness
spells.description: Make a ranged spell attack. On hit, deal 2d8 Poison damage and the target is Poisoned until the end of your next turn.
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d8 for each level above 1.

spells.name: Sanctuary
spells.description: Ward a creature. Attackers/spells targeting it must succeed on a Wisdom save or choose a new target/lose the attack. Doesn't protect from area effects. Ends if warded creature attacks, casts, or deals damage.

spells.name: Searing Smite
spells.description: Take as a Bonus Action after hitting with a Melee weapon or Unarmed Strike. Target takes extra 1d6 Fire damage. At start of its turns, it takes 1d6 Fire damage and makes a Con save. Success ends the spell.
spells.upcast: All damage increases by 1d6 for each level above 1.

spells.name: Shield
spells.description: Take a Reaction when hit or targeted by Magic Missile. Until your next turn, gain +5 to AC (including against the trigger) and take no damage from Magic Missile.

spells.name: Shield of Faith
spells.description: A creature you choose within range gains a +2 bonus to AC.

spells.name: Silent Image
spells.description: Create a visual illusion (up to 15ft Cube). Use a Magic action to move it and alter its appearance. Physical interaction or a Study action vs spell DC reveals it as an illusion.

spells.name: Sleep
spells.description: Each creature of your choice in a 5-foot-radius Sphere must make a Wisdom save or be Incapacitated until its next turn, then repeat the save. Failure on second save: Unconscious for duration. Ends if damaged or shaken as an action. Creatures that don't sleep or are immune to Exhaustion auto-succeed.

spells.name: Speak with Animals
spells.description: Comprehend and verbally communicate with Beasts. You can use any Influence action skill options with them.

spells.name: Tasha's Hideous Laughter
spells.description: Force a Wisdom save on a creature you see. Fail: Prone and Incapacitated, and it can't stand up. Repeat save at end of its turns and when damaged (Advantage on damage save). Success ends the spell.
spells.upcast: Target one additional creature for each level above 1.

spells.name: Tenser's Floating Disk
spells.description: Create a 3ft diameter disk of force that floats 3ft above the ground and holds up to 500 lbs. It follows you (within 20ft) if you move >20ft away. Ends if you move >100ft away or weight exceeded.

spells.name: Thunderous Smite
spells.description: Take as a Bonus Action immediately after hitting with a Melee weapon or Unarmed Strike. Target takes extra 2d6 Thunder damage. If a creature, it makes a Strength save or is pushed 10ft and knocked Prone. Audible within 300ft.
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d6 for each level above 1.

spells.name: Thunderwave
spells.description: Each creature in a 15-foot Cube makes a Constitution save. Fail: 2d8 Thunder damage and pushed 10ft. Success: half damage. Unsecured objects pushed 10ft. Audible within 300ft.
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d8 for each level above 1.

spells.name: Unseen Servant
spells.description: Create an Invisible, mindless Medium force to perform simple tasks. Use a Bonus Action to command it (move 15ft and interact). Ends if it moves >60ft from you.

spells.name: Witch Bolt
spells.description: Make a ranged spell attack: 2d12 Lightning damage on hit. On subsequent turns, use a Bonus Action to automatically deal 1d12 Lightning damage (even if initial attack missed). Ends if target is >60ft away or has Total Cover.
spells.upcast: Initial damage increases by 1d12 for each level above 1.

spells.name: Wrathful Smite
spells.description: Take as a Bonus Action immediately after hitting with a Melee weapon or Unarmed Strike. Target takes extra 1d6 Necrotic damage and makes a Wisdom save or is Frightened for the duration (repeat save at end of its turns).
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d6 for each level above 1.

spells.name: Absorb Elements
spells.description: Take a Reaction when taking Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage. Gain Resistance to that type until your next turn. Your first melee hit on your next turn deals an extra 1d6 damage of that type.
spells.upcast: Extra damage increases by 1d6 for each level above 1.

spells.name: Beast Bond
spells.description: Establish a telepathic link with a friendly or Charmed Beast (Int < 4) within line of sight. While linked, the beast has Advantage on attack rolls against creatures you can see within 5ft of you.

spells.name: Catapult
spells.description: Launch an object (1-5 lbs) 90ft in a line. If it strikes a creature, they make a Dexterity save. Fail: both take 3d8 Bludgeoning damage. Success: object continues.
spells.upcast: Max weight +5 lbs and damage +1d8 for each level above 1.

spells.name: Cause Fear
spells.description: Force a Wisdom save on a creature (not Construct/Undead). Fail: target is Frightened. Repeat save at end of its turns.
spells.upcast: Target one additional creature for each level above 1 (within 30ft of each other).

spells.name: Ceremony
spells.description: Perform a rite: Atonement (Alignment), Bless Water (Holy Water), Coming of Age (+1d4 checks for 24h), Dedication (+1d4 saves for 24h), Funeral Rite (can't become Undead for 7d), or Wedding (+2 AC within 30ft for 7d).

spells.name: Chaos Bolt
spells.description: Make a ranged spell attack for 2d8 + 1d6 damage. One d8 determines type (1:Acid, 2:Cold, 3:Fire, 4:Force, 5:Lightning, 6:Poison, 7:Psychic, 8:Thunder). If d8s are same, it leaps to another target within 30ft (new rolls).
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d6 for each level above 1.

spells.name: Distort Value
spells.description: Make an object (5ft Cube) appear worth 2x or 1/2 actual value. Investigation vs spell DC to see through.

spells.name: Earth Tremor
spells.description: Creatures within 10ft make a Dexterity save. Fail: 1d6 Bludgeoning damage and knocked Prone. Loose ground becomes Difficult Terrain.
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d6 for each level above 1.

spells.name: Frost Fingers
spells.description: Each creature in a 15ft cone makes a Constitution save. Fail: 2d8 Cold damage and Speed -10ft. Success: half damage. Freezes nonmagical liquids.
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d8 for each level above 1.

spells.name: Gift of Alacrity
spells.description: Willing creature adds 1d8 to Initiative rolls.

spells.name: Jim's Magic Missile
spells.description: Create 3 whistles of force. Make a ranged spell attack for each: 2d4 Force damage. Nat 1: miss and you take 1 Force damage. Nat 20: deals 5d4 damage.
spells.upcast: Create one more missile for each level above 1.

spells.name: Magnify Gravity
spells.description: 10ft-radius Sphere of force. Creatures make a Constitution save. Fail: 2d8 Force damage and Speed halved. Success: half damage. Objects in area are heavier.
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d8 for each level above 1.

spells.name: Silvery Barbs
spells.description: Use a Reaction when a creature succeeds on an attack/check/save. They must reroll and use the lower roll. You then grant Advantage on the next attack/check/save to a different creature (or yourself) within 1 minute.

spells.name: Snare
spells.description: Create a 5ft-radius magic trap. S/M/L creature entering must succeed on a Dexterity save or be hoisted upside down (Restrained). Repeat save at end of turns or others can attempt an Arcana check vs DC to free them.

spells.name: Tasha's Caustic Brew
spells.description: 30ft line of acid. Creatures make a Dexterity save or take 2d4 Acid damage at the start of each turn. Action to wash off.
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 2d4 for each level above 1.

spells.name: Zephyr Strike
spells.description: Movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks. Once before spell ends: gain Advantage on one weapon attack (+1d8 Force damage) and walking speed increases by 30ft until end of turn.
